meta.name: historical-interview-scripts
meta.description: 自媒体创作者在策划历史名人访谈短视频时，当需要融合古今反差与网络热梗打造爆款，使用本技能可自动生成包含吸睛标题、主持人串词与爆笑问答的完整结构化脚本，轻松产出高传播力的趣味短视频文案。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把历史名人访谈变成自带热梗的爆笑短视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是做历史类短视频的创作者,想快速产出有梗的访谈脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn historical figure interviews into viral short-video scripts with internet memes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a short-video creator making history content and need quick meme-driven interview scripts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演短视频编剧，产出历史名人虚构访谈文案：吸睛标题、嘉宾梗概、主持人串词、问答正文与互动引导，并按固定 Markdown 格式输出。
howto.when: 当你要求创作历史人物访谈、趣味历史短视频文案等，或指定某位历史人物做「现代访谈秀」式虚构采访时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a short-video scriptwriter: it produces fictional interview scripts with historical figures — title, guest summary, host intro, Q&A body and a closing call to action — in a fixed Markdown format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a historical-figure interview, a fun history short-video script, or a fictional 'modern talk show' interview with a named figure.

say_en.text: Write a talk-show script interviewing Li Bai about modern career choices.
say_en.note: Outputs the full script in the fixed Markdown template.

say_en.text: Script an interview with Qin Shi Huang and Wu Zetian on ancient CEO management.
say_en.note: Includes title, host intro, Q&A and interaction prompt.

say_en.text: Write a brain-hole interview script where Li Qingzhao roasts Su Shi.
say_en.note: Can add cross-time duos and banter.
